note:
Maxtoke Road on the 1901 census - one household of six, read from the enumerator's page and checked by A. Hagues. The record holds nothing for this street in 1901.

**It is unfiled, and for a reason worth recording.** Schedule 185 is headed "Maxtoke Rd, Burton House". The record holds exactly one property on Maxtoke Road - **#202, 6 Maxtoke Road, whose house name is Stowe House** - and it holds a **Burton House on Newcastle Circus (#205)**, a different street.

So the name on the page matches a house the record keeps somewhere else, and the house the record keeps here carries a different name. Filing this household at either would be a guess, and a guess of exactly the kind that has put households on the wrong street before. Elizabeth A. Watson, a widow of 65 living on her own means with a companion and four servants, waits until the two Burton Houses are told apart.
source: 1901 census enumerator's page for Maxtoke Road, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
